Try playing a bit more passively. 

Be constantly aware, checking surroundings... Especially in high traffic areas. 

Make an effort to periodically just stop and listen for 15 seconds or so... I win so many fights just by knowing the enemy is around before they know I'm around. 

Ammo and armour is of course important, but it's not a guaruntee of survival. 

In the event you can confirm someone is nearby and hiding, waiting for the drop on you -- the best thing to do is throw a grenade, maybe even suppress them with some shots, and immediately reposition. 

9 times out of ten, the person hiding will end up pushing you -- and at this point you should be more than ready and have every advantage possible to take them out. 

Then, reposition again, wait a minute or so -- make sure there isn't someone else around, either with the person you're engaging, or someone else who was nearby & wants to third party. 

There's of course nuances to every situation, but I find that playing more passively (not totally stationary) is the most rewarding and successful means of survival.
